author: Bobby Grayson
description: Task additionally needs beh_isolated (no link/spawnLink/signal effect) through the new applyEffects_links_signals_of_isolated because Grows only gives superset of links/signals, while Task's Inv demands links = [] and signals = [].
title: Key simplification: for any pid p ≠ 0 the step is message-independent: Inv.set_ne (frame_set) then Grows (applyEffects_grows), or Inv.terminate_frame on the Grows.frame; runE_cases supplies the split. Worker case analyses (5-7 messages each) vanish. Only pid 0's step looks at the message, and even its no-op cases are dog_noop/sup_noop + Grows without reducing applyEffects
